CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GIRISH KATHPALIA  ORDER % 03.02.2026
1. Petitioner seeks quashing of case FIR No. 324/2013 of Police Station K.N. Katju Marg for offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC.
2. After addressing partly, learned counsel for petitioner seeks permission to withdraw this petition with liberty to file afresh after executing a compromise with the complainant de facto.
3. As requested, the petition and the accompanying application are dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as sought.
